title: MCS-90 endorsement (Endorsement for Motor Carrier Policies of Insurance for Public Liability)

form_number.description: Form number printed in the header, e.g. FORM MCS-90.

form_revision.description: Form revision printed in the page 1 footer, e.g. Rev 5/26/2023.

omb_number.description: OMB control number printed in the header.

omb_expiration_date.description: OMB expiration date printed in the header, exactly as printed.

usdot_number.description: USDOT Number box at the top right of page 1, or null if blank.

date_received.description: Date Received box at the top right of page 1, or null if blank.

motor_carrier.description: The motor carrier the endorsement is issued to.

name.description: Motor carrier name written on the 'Issued to' line.

state_or_province.description: Motor carrier state or province written on the 'of' line below the carrier name.

dated_at.description: The 'Dated at ... on this ... day of ..., ...' line: where and when the endorsement was signed.

place.description: City and state written after 'Dated at', exactly as printed.

day.description: Day written after 'on this', exactly as printed, e.g. 21st.

amending_policy_number.description: The policy number written after 'Amending Policy Number:' (not the effective date on the same line).

effective_date.description: The date written after 'Effective Date:' on the same line as the policy number, exactly as printed.

insurance_company.description: Name written after 'Name of Insurance Company:'.

countersigned.description: True if the 'Countersigned by' line carries a signature.

coverage.description: The primary-or-excess choice and its limits (check only one).

basis.description: Which box is checked: 'primary' if 'This insurance is primary' is checked, 'excess' if 'This insurance is excess' is checked.

primary_limit_per_accident.description: Amount written on the primary line ('not be liable for amounts in excess of $ ... for each accident'), exactly as printed without the dollar sign, or null if blank.

excess_limit_per_accident.description: Amount written on the excess line, exactly as printed, or null if blank.

underlying_limit_per_accident.description: Underlying limit written on the excess line, exactly as printed, or null if blank.

fmcsa_verification_phone.description: Telephone number the FMCSA calls to verify the policy is in force, exactly as printed.

cancellation_notice_days_to_party.description: Days of written notice to the other party required to cancel the endorsement.

cancellation_notice_days_to_fmcsa.description: Days of notice to the FMCSA required to cancel the endorsement.

schedule_of_limits.description: Page 3, Schedule of Limits - Public Liability: one row per type of carriage.

type_of_carriage.description: Type of carriage, including its row number, e.g. (1) For-hire ...

minimum_insurance.description: Minimum insurance amount for this row as of January 1, 1985, exactly as printed, e.g. $750,000.
